close_reason: Added two-line comment at partition() call: 'Pass 1 = role-vacating; pass 2 = everything else. This ordering allows a single request to swap roles atomically.'
description: The two-pass update loop in handle_mailbox_set is correct and well-commented, but the terms 'vacating' and 'non-vacating' are invented vocabulary not present in RFC 8621. The block comment explains the rationale but a contributor encountering this for the first time (or returning to it in 12 months) must re-read the entire comment to understand why two passes are needed. Suggested: add a one-line comment at the partition() call: // Two-pass to allow role swaps in one request: pass 1 clears roles, pass 2 claims them.
title: Mailbox/set two-pass update: intent of 'vacating' vs 'non-vacating' requires reading full comment
